course.title: Utility Services and Infrastructure Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A Gas Distribution Company manages three warehouses and four market places. The company has estimated the requirements for gas cylinders at each market place in no. of cylinders. The company knows the no. of cylinders available at each warehouse. Prepare a network chart of deliverable cylinders from warehouses to market places at minimum shipping cost and calculate the total cost.
